title: Malicious app invitation
summary: A message asks you to install an app or package to continue a conversation or receive a benefit.
scenario: The install request bypasses a normal app store or asks for broad permissions.
warning_signs: Permissions unrelated to the claimed purpose
safe_actions: Use the official app store or known provider app
recovery_guidance: Uninstall the unknown app and review device settings
Change credentials from a safe device if entered
reporting_guidance: Keep the message and app name without redistributing the file
prevention_tips: Do not grant remote or accessibility access casually
false_positive_notes: Some organizations distribute apps outside stores, but the publisher and package must be independently verified first.
